page: Amazon Web Services g7.48xlarge is a graphics-intensive GPU-accelerated server built on the AWS Nitro System hypervisor. The instance features 192 dedicated physical Intel x86_64 CPU cores operating at a clock speed of 3.9 GHz without multi-threading. System memory totals 768 GB of RAM, providing 4 GB of memory per CPU core.

For accelerated workloads, the instance comes equipped with 8 NVIDIA Blackwell RTX PRO 4500 GPUs, delivering a combined VRAM capacity of 256 GB across the array. Storage performance is supported by 7,600 GB of attached local NVMe SSD storage. High-throughput network communication is facilitated by a 350 Gbps baseline network bandwidth specification.

From a cost efficiency perspective, bundling 8 dedicated GPUs, large local NVMe SSD storage, and 350 Gbps networking into a single high-density node reduces multi-node orchestration overhead for resource-heavy workloads. This instance is suited for graphics rendering, 3D spatial computation, video processing pipelines, and parallelized machine learning workloads.
